segments.sn37.14:1.1: “Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo … pe … nirayaṃ upapajjati.
segments.sn37.14:1.3: Pāṇātipātī ca hoti, adinnādāyī ca hoti, kāmesumicchācārī ca hoti, musāvādī ca hoti, surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhāyī ca hoti – imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjatī”ti.
segments.sn37.14:2.1: Mātugāmo puriso ca, āveṇikā tidhammo ca [dve manāpāmanāpāca, āveṇikā tīhi anuruddho (sabbattha)];
segments.sn37.14:2.3: Kodhano upanāhī ca, issukī maccharena ca;
segments.sn37.14:2.5: Aticārī ca dussīlo, appassuto ca kusīto;
